g.text: RICK & MORTY PORTAL GUN — PHYSICAL WIRING DIAGRAM (ARDUINO NANO ESP32)
Wokwi High-Fidelity Hardware Map | 2S LiPo 850mAh | I2S Audio | WS2812B | TM1637
• 3A Inline Fuse placed immediately off Battery (+) prevents short-circuit fires.
• Switched 7.4V-8.4V feeds Nano ESP32 VIN directly: isolates MCU from 5V audio/LED dips!
• Mini360 Buck Converter trims 7.4V down to exactly +5.0V for the NeoPixels & I2S Amp.
• 1000 µF 10V capacitor across +5V and GND absorbs heavy LED inrush spikes.
⚠️ DANGER: Connect Joystick VCC strictly to Nano ESP32 3.3V Out, NEVER 5V!
• ESP32-S3 ADC inputs (A0, A1) are strictly 3.3V-tolerant. 5V will permanently burn the ADC.
• D11 ➔ BCLK (Bit Clock), D12 ➔ LRC (Word Select), D13 ➔ DIN (Serial PCM Data).
⚠️ Speaker SPK- is a differential Bridge-Tied Load (BTL): NEVER CONNECT SPK- TO GND!
4. WS2812B NEOPIXELS & DISPLAY (LED-01, LED-02, DSP-01, DSP-02):
• D5 ➔ 330Ω ➔ Barrel Ring DIN (7 LEDs), D6 ➔ 330Ω ➔ Top Fluid Strip DIN (8 LEDs).
• D7 ➔ TM1637 CLK, D8 ➔ TM1637 DIO (4-Digit Red Display).
5. CONTROLS & DEEP SLEEP WAKE (INP-01 to INP-04):
• VRX ➔ A0, VRY ➔ A1, Joystick SW ➔ D9 (Uses ESP32 internal INPUT_PULLUP).
• Sleep/Wake Button ➔ D10 (ESP32-S3 RTC_GPIO21 EXT0 wake source).
